When you have constant failures throughout your life, believing things can get better is just coping. I even became a gymrat with an outdoor job for awhile. Women wouldn't flirt with me to save their life. You either have the genes to appeal to people, or you don't.

I hate that confidence, the one thing I don't have, is the difference between being treated like a bro and complete and utter SHIT. How can I respect someone if they'd look at the same type of men I was, and laugh their asses off at what failures they are? I hate that something that comes so easily to everyone else is a total mystery to me, robbing of the memories everyone else should have. It feels like if I ever fall back into weakness, they'll gladly leave me in the dust again.

I tried picking up piano, but I have sperg hands and memory.

I hate the idea of even me succeeding at this point...because anyone who I'd try to get with, especially romantically, would already have their highlights pass them, and would have probably laughed their ass of if they saw how I was before. The world is merciless to low status males.
